name: Gusto
one_liner: Modern payroll and HR platform for small businesses. Full-service payroll, benefits, and compliance from $40/month + $6/person.
short_description: Gusto is a cloud-based payroll and HR platform that handles payroll processing, tax filings, benefits administration, and compliance for small to medium businesses including group therapy practices.
long_description: Gusto provides full-service payroll, benefits administration, and HR tools for small businesses. For group therapy practices, it handles W-2 employee payroll with automatic tax calculations and filings, direct deposit, health insurance and 401(k) administration, PTO tracking, and new hire onboarding. Gusto automatically files federal, state, and local payroll taxes. The platform also supports contractor payments (1099s) for practices using independent contractors. Pricing starts at $40/month base plus $6 per person for the Simple plan.

pricing.notes: Contractor-only plan available at $35/month + $6/contractor for practices using only 1099 contractors.

compliance.notes: Gusto is not HIPAA compliant. Use for payroll/HR only, not clinical data.
